source: Compiled from Caterpillar published specifications, August 2026
note: Nominal specs; individual units vary by configuration. Match to inventory via model number.

models.Cat 262D: Vertical-lift skid steer loader. Cat C3.3B DIT engine, 74.3 hp gross. Rated operating capacity 2,700 lb (50% tipping). Operating weight ~8,055 lb. High-flow XPS auxiliary hydraulics optional. Predecessor to the D3 series. Common in construction, landscaping, snow work with attachments (buckets, forks, brooms, snow pushes).
models.Cat 262D3: Current-generation vertical-lift skid steer. Cat C3.3B engine, 74.3 hp. Rated operating capacity 2,700 lb. Operating weight ~8,269 lb. Updated cab, sealed and pressurized option, advanced display available. Same attachment ecosystem as 262D.
models.Cat 242D3: Smaller vertical-lift skid steer. Cat C2.2 turbo engine, ~67 hp. Rated operating capacity 2,150 lb. Operating weight ~7,270 lb. Compact footprint for tighter sites; shares D3-series cab and controls.
models.Cat 259D: Vertical-lift compact track loader. Cat C3.3B engine, 74.3 hp. Rated operating capacity 2,010 lb (35% tipping). Operating weight ~9,150 lb. Suspended undercarriage, rubber tracks — flotation and low ground pressure vs wheeled skid steer.
models.Cat 259D3: Current-generation version of the 259D. Cat C3.3B, 74.3 hp. Rated operating capacity 2,010 lb at 35%. Operating weight ~9,379 lb. Updated cab and displays; most popular CTL size class for general construction and landscaping.
models.Cat 907M: Compact wheel loader. Cat C3.3B engine, ~74 hp. Operating weight ~12,500 lb. Bucket capacity ~0.9–1.2 m³ (1.2–1.6 yd³). Hydrostatic drive, optional high-speed. Articulated steering, skid-steer-coupler compatible option for attachment sharing. Yard work, ag, snow, material rehandling.
models.Cat 303.5 (303.5-07): 3.5-tonne mini excavator. Cat C1.7 engine, ~23.5 hp. Operating weight ~8,270 lb. Max dig depth ~10'2". Standard/long stick options, angle blade available, joystick controls with Stick Steer. Tight-space utility, residential, landscaping.
models.Cat 304 (304-07): 4-tonne class mini. Cat C1.7, ~40 hp gross (C1.7T). Operating weight ~9,260 lb. Max dig depth ~10'5". First size with more counterweight stability for heavier buckets/thumbs.
models.Cat 305 (305-07): 5-tonne class mini, the highest-volume mini size. Cat C1.7T, ~40+ hp net. Operating weight ~11,464 lb. Max dig depth ~11'1". Swing boom, expandable stick options; handles hydraulic thumbs, augers, breakers.
models.Cat 306 (306-07): 6-tonne class mini. Cat C2.4T, ~40+ hp (larger frame, ~57 hp on CR variants). Operating weight ~13,500–14,300 lb. Max dig depth ~12'6". Bridges mini and small excavator work; can load tandem trucks.
models.Cat 308E2 CR SB: 8-tonne compact-radius mini with swing boom. Cat C3.3B DIT, ~65.5 hp. Operating weight ~18,300 lb. Max dig depth ~13'7". Compact radius tail for roadside/urban work; swing boom digs offset against walls.
models.Cat 311F LRR: 11-tonne reduced-radius excavator. Cat C3.4B, ~70 hp. Operating weight ~26,000 lb. Max dig depth ~15'8". Reduced tail swing for road and utility work; sits between mini and 13-tonne classes.
models.Cat 313 (313-07, Next Gen): 13-tonne excavator. Cat C3.6, ~107 hp net. Operating weight ~30,400 lb. Max dig depth ~18'4". Next Gen cab, optional Grade with 2D, Payload. Utility and light site work.
models.Cat 323 (323-07, Next Gen): 23-tonne excavator, the volume class. Cat C7.1, ~162 hp net. Operating weight ~50,900 lb. Max dig depth ~22'1". Standard Grade with 2D, Grade Assist, Payload, E-Fence. General earthmoving, site development, trenching.
models.Cat 325 (325-07, Next Gen): 25-tonne class. Cat C7.1, ~172 hp net. Operating weight ~56,000 lb. Max dig depth ~22'6". Slightly more lift and stability than the 323 for the same transport class.
models.Cat 330F L: 30-tonne F-series (long undercarriage). Cat C7.1 ACERT, ~239 hp net. Operating weight ~68,300 lb. Max dig depth ~24'4". Production digging, mass excavation feeder class, truck loading.
models.Cat 349F L: 50-tonne F-series. Cat C13 ACERT, ~425 hp. Operating weight ~108,000 lb. Max dig depth ~26'. Heavy production excavation, quarry face work, large hammers.
models.Cat 352 (352-07, Next Gen): 52-tonne class, replaced the 352F. Cat C13/C13B, ~424 hp net. Operating weight ~110,500–113,500 lb. Max dig depth 26'11", max reach 39'10". Bucket capacity up to 3.21 m³. Standard Grade with 2D, Payload, Lift Assist, E-Fence; optional variable-gauge undercarriage retracts to 7'10" for transport. Big-job counterpart to the 349F.
models.Cat D1 (D1-12): Small dozer, replaced the D3K2. Cat C3.6, 80 hp net. Operating weight ~17,855 lb (LGP ~19,295 lb). Blade capacity 2.17 yd³. Fully hydrostatic transmission, Slope Assist standard, Grade with 3D optional. Finish grading, residential pads, light clearing.
models.Cat D3K XL: Previous-generation small dozer (K2 series). Cat C4.4 ACERT, ~80 hp. Operating weight ~17,700 lb. XL = extra-long track for finish grading stability. Hydrostatic. Same class as the current D1.
models.Cat D6T XL / D6T XLVP: 20-tonne class medium dozer. Cat C9.3 ACERT, ~215 hp net (varies by year/tier). Operating weight ~44,500–46,500 lb. XL = extra-long undercarriage; VP = variable-pitch power-angle-tilt (VPAT) blade. Differential steer. Production dozing, grading, pushing scrapers. High-hour units common; undercarriage percentage is the key condition question.
models.Cat 420F IT: 14-ft class backhoe loader. Cat C4.4 ACERT, ~93 hp net. Operating weight ~24,000 lb typical. IT = Integrated Toolcarrier front linkage (parallel lift, quick coupler for forks/buckets). Backhoe dig depth ~14'4" (E-stick extends to ~18'). The utility contractor standard.
models.Cat TL1055D: 10,000 lb / 55 ft telehandler. Cat C4.4, ~124 hp. Max lift capacity 10,000 lb, max lift height ~55'. Boom-mounted, frame-leveling, outriggers. Steel erection, masonry, general construction material placement.
models.Cat 730 (730-04): Three-axle 6x6 articulated truck. Cat C13/C13B, 375 hp gross / 367 hp net. Rated payload 28 tonnes (31 US tons), heaped body 17.5 m³ (23 yd³). CX31 6F/1R powershift, all-axle enclosed wet brakes, Advanced Automatic Traction Control, Stability Assist. Pass-matched with 349/352 excavators and 966/972 loaders.
models.Cat AD60: Underground articulated mining truck — largest in the AD line until the AD63. Cat C27 ACERT/VR (27 L), gross power 751/776 hp (1st gear / 2nd-7th). Nominal payload 60,000 kg (132,277 lb). Gross machine weight 112,000 kg. Body capacities 26.9–36.6 m³. Seven-speed planetary powershift with lock-up torque converter, four-wheel forced-oil-cooled disc brakes with Automatic Retarder Control, VIMS monitoring, Truck Payload Measurement System. Hard-rock haulage on decline ramps; near-continuous duty cycles mean high hour meters read as utilization, not wear-out.
models.Cat 2C5000: LP gas cushion-tire IC forklift. 5,000 lb capacity at 24" load center. GK25 2.5L LP engine, powershift transmission. Truck weight ~8,110 lb, turning radius ~79.5". Mast options from two-stage (~131" lift) to three-stage (187–218") and four-stage. Indoor warehouse/manufacturing on smooth floors. "2C5000 LIN" in inventory denotes a configuration variant of the same model. - Cascade MFG 300D CFS — material handling arm attachments for crushers - Jungheinrich ETR345 — electric reach trucks (forklifts)
